basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original opaque full-bleed oil painting for a medieval dark-fantasy civilization Structure card. Seek the storytelling compositional mastery of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: bold architectural silhouette, monumental scale, expressive visible oil brushwork, large quiet color planes and one controlled focal light. Early twentieth-century adventure-book illustration, not photorealistic or glossy digital fantasy. The named building is the unmistakable dominant subject and fills the central 75 percent, separated from a simple contrasting background. Include two or three TINY human figures only to show scale, all faces indiscernible. No intricate ornament, tiny clutter, text, letters, signs, symbols, decorative border, interface or vignette. assets.scriptorium: Upright 3:4. A tall narrow stone scriptorium with one great arched upper window glowing ivory above a modest dark entrance; three tiny hooded scribes carry scrolls through the doorway. The window is the focal shape, muted slate walls and cold sky.
assets.library: Landscape 3:2. A substantial old stone library with broad steps, a high central reading window and flanking book-filled wings visible in shadow. Three tiny cloaked visitors ascend, faces hidden. One warm lit window against cool grey stone is focal, the roofline a simple broad mass.
assets.archive: Landscape 3:2. A formidable low stone archive with a deep recessed door beneath huge blind walls and a single clerestory light slot. Three tiny faceless keepers carry document chests toward the entrance. The dark doorway and one pale shaft of light create the focus; strong sealed architectural silhouette.
assets.blackArchive: Landscape 3:2. A secret severe black-stone archive embedded into a cliff, its narrow tall entrance lit by one dark crimson lantern. Three tiny hooded visitors approach across a bridge. Immense blank masonry and cliff shadow convey scale; distinct from the ordinary archive, no occult glyphs.
assets.anatomistsCollege: Landscape 3:2. A high stone medical college with a round amphitheatre wing and one broad skylight, two tiny hooded students crossing a forecourt with a covered stretcher. A pale shaft through the circular roof is the focal feature; quiet grey-brown architecture, respectful mood.
assets.technicalWorkshop: Upright 3:4. One tall timber-and-stone technical workshop with a huge exposed water-driven gear visible through an open bay. Three tiny workers stand by the wheel. The gear's warm brass hub against dark walls is the focal shape; crisp simple silhouette, not an ordinary cottage.
assets.foundry: Landscape 3:2. One vast early iron foundry with a square furnace tower and high smoke chimney, orange light spilling from a large casting bay. Three tiny silhouetted workers at the entrance show monumental industrial scale. Tower, chimney and glowing doorway are the only bold shapes.
assets.glasshouse: Upright 3:4. One medieval glassworks hall with a tall glazed roof, a brick furnace, and broad green-blue glass panels catching light. Three tiny faceless workers stand by the entry carrying long blowpipes. The luminous translucent roof is focal; architecture bold and uncluttered.
assets.observatory: Landscape 3:2. One high stone observatory perched above sheer cliffs, with a simple round viewing dome opened toward a pale moon. Three tiny hooded scholars on a terrace show scale. Dome and slit of moonlight make the singular focal shape; huge dark-blue sky restful.
assets.academy: Wide landscape 9:4 composition centered for horizontal crop. A grand medieval academy on a high terrace, one monumental central hall flanked by low wings and a broad stair. Three tiny cloaked scholars climbing show its enormous scale. Pale dawn illuminates the hall doorway, broad slate roof and warm stone masses remain simple.
assets.lyceum: Landscape 3:2. A classical but rugged medieval lyceum around an open colonnaded courtyard, one great arch and a simple roofline. Three tiny hooded scholars cross the courtyard; a warm circle of light at its central doorway is focal. Monumental yet welcoming stone scale, no banners or writing.
